# nginxproxymanager_user (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nginxproxymanager_user" "user" {
  id = 123
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the user (required).

### Read-Only

- `avatar` (String) URL to the avatar for the user.
- `email` (String) Email of the user, used for logging in.
- `is_disabled` (Boolean) Whether the user is disabled or not.
- `name` (String) Username of the user.
- `nickname` (String) Nickname for the user.
- `roles` (List of String) A list of roles that the user has.
